title: The queen speaks with Ammon
summary: Ammon went in to the queen and asked what she wanted him to do. She relayed what her husband's servants had told her about Ammon and asked him to see her husband. She said her husband had been on his bed for two days and two nights, reported differing opinions about whether he was dead, and said he did not stink to her.

The queen said her husband's servants had told her that Ammon was a prophet of a holy God and had power to do mighty works in his name.
The queen asked Ammon to see her husband and said he had been laid on his bed for two days and two nights.
The queen reported that some said her husband was not dead, while others said he was dead and ought to be placed in the sepulchre. She said he did not stink to her.
